chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Returns to Face the Dragon King of the Southern Wastes
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen reunites with old friends and confronts Long Teng in a brutal battle, but the Heaven-Overturning Seal of the Chan Sect appears at the climax.
